minutes_text:
Parking and Traffic Commission
  City of Inglewood Chambers Room on Ninth Floor
  One West Manchester Blvd.Inglewood, CA 90301

  JANUARY 2020 MEETING MINUTES

1. Roll Call
  a. A meeting of the Parking and Traffic Commission was held at the City of Inglewood located on the 9th Floor at
  7:16 pm.
  b. Attendees included:
  Charles Braggs, District 1  Peter Puglese, TE, PE, City Traffic Engineer
  Barbara Brooks, District 4  Diana Maximo, Serco Manager
  Brett C.S. Roberts, District 3  Lieutenant Cardell Hurt, Traffic Unit Commander

2. Approval of Minutes for January 22, 2020
  a. Motion to accept the meeting minutes was made by Commissioner Barbara Brooks. Seconded by Commissioner
  Charles Braggs. Meeting minutes approval 2-3 from Commissioners

3. Public Comments
  a. Resident wants the City’s Parking Enforcement to patrol Crenshaw Boulevard from Century Blvd to Imperial
  Highway more often. Commissioners were informed that the residents want to see the City respond quickly to calls.
  Lieutenant Cardell Hurt and Diana Maximo will work together to monitor this area and provide support to the
  citizens. Answering resident calls due to vehicle parking problems, specifically to this area, the City will continue
  to give special attention in the best possible way.

4. Unfinished Business
  a. None

  a. None

  a. None

  a. None
